# Execute moves: Move each watch product from wish list to cart with specified quantity.

pwds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
amazon_pwd = [p['password'] for p in pwds if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
access_token = apis.amazon.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=amazon_pwd)['access_token']

wish = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
watches = [item for item in wish if item.get('product_type','').lower()=='watch']

cart_before = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
current_cart_ids = [ci['product_id'] for ci in cart_before.get('cart_items',[])]

moves = []
for w in watches:
    pid = int(w['product_id'])
    qty = int(w.get('quantity', 1))
    moves.append({'product_id': pid, 'quantity': qty, 'product_name': w['product_name']})

delta = [m for m in moves if m['product_id'] not in current_cart_ids]
print('Delta to move:', [(m['product_id'], m['quantity']) for m in delta])

results = []
for m in delta:
    r = apis.amazon.move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart(product_id=m['product_id'], quantity=m['quantity'], access_token=access_token)
    results.append((m['product_id'], r))
print('Move results:')
for pid, r in results:
    print(pid, r)

cart_after = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
print('Cart after:', cart_after)

# Verify wishlist after moves: ensure watch products removed
pwds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
amazon_pwd = [p['password'] for p in pwds if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
access_token = apis.amazon.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=amazon_pwd)['access_token']

wish_after = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=access_token)
watches_after = [item for item in wish_after if item.get('product_type','').lower()=='watch']
print('Wishlist watch items after:', len(watches_after))
print([(w['product_id'], w['product_name'], w['quantity']) for w in watches_after])

# Expected moved product_ids
expected_moved_pids = {1397, 1400, 1402, 1409}
after_pids = {int(w['product_id']) for w in watches_after}
print('Expected moved pids:', sorted(expected_moved_pids))
print('Still in wishlist (watch pids):', sorted(after_pids))
print('Missing from wishlist (should be empty):', sorted(expected_moved_pids - after_pids))
